description_excerpt: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. JOB CONTEXT Damen Song Cam Shipyard (DSCS) is engineering, building, outfitting, commissioning and delivering ship types of the Damen range. Basic designs and most components are delivered to DSCS by Damen Workboat in Gorinchem. DSCS will complete the detailed design, produce all required production instructions, supplement the remaining components either by their own production or by purchasing / subcontracting and provide project management. DSCS consists of four big departments: Engineering, Projects, Operations, and Finance.…
